kit.description: Version of the component kit and of this manifest format. A viewer declares the range it supports.

id.description: Stable slug; also the directory name under .codemap/explainers/. Re-applying a card with the same id replaces it.

questions.description: The reader's own words. Used for search and for finding an existing card before writing a new one.

summary.description: Plain text; one or two sentences shown under the title.

anchors.description: What the card explains: a file path, a symbol id `path#Qual.name`, or `region:<id>`. The viewer checks they exist and records their hashes for staleness.

anchor_hashes.description: Written by `apply`/`confirm`: content hash of each anchor when the card was written or last confirmed. A different hash now means the code changed since.

run.description: Written by `apply`: the run that last wrote the card.

at.description: Written by `apply`: ISO timestamp of that run.
